# Inclusive Inc

> > Assistive technology and adaptive equipment supplier specializing in mobility aids, environmental controls, and independent living solutions for people with disabilities.

Inclusive Inc operates from North Fort Myers, Florida, offering specialized products through Inclusive Technologies and Inclusive Homebase divisions. The company provides innovative solutions ranging from powered orthoses like PowerGrip to ceiling lifts, wheelchair accessories, and environmental control systems for individuals with quadriplegia, reduced mobility, and other disabilities.

## Mobility & Transfer Equipment

- [PowerGrip Assisted Grasp Orthosis Add-on Kit for tenodesis or ratchet-style orthosis](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/powergrip): PowerGrip wrist-hand orthosis for quadriplegics lacking grasp strength
- [Handicare Independent Lifter for Patient Ceiling Lifts](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/mobile-lift-for-people-with-reduced-mobility): Handicare ceiling lift system for independent patient transfers
- [Medcare Heavy Duty C-1000 Ceiling Lift Bundle](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/medcare-pro-heavy-duty-ceiling-lift): Medcare C-1000 heavy-duty ceiling lift system up to 1000 lbs capacity
- [Safety Stop v2 Wireless Remote Wheelchair Kill Switch](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/safety-stop-v2-wireless-remote-wheelchair-kill-switch): RF wireless kill switch for power wheelchairs, no installation required
- [Wheelchair Ramp 2FT Foldable Aluminum Threshold Ramp with Non-Slip Surface](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/wheelchair-ramp-2ft-foldable-aluminum-threshold-ramp-with-non-slip-surface-and-handle-700lbs-weight-capacity-ideal-for-steps-2-to-4-inches-high-quality-welded-no-rivets): HOMCOM 2ft foldable aluminum wheelchair ramp with 700lb capacity

## Wheelchair Accessories & Daily Living

- [Comfort Robe - Shower Wheelchair Bathrobe](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/robe): Adaptive bathrobe for wheelchair users providing bathroom privacy
- [Liberty Lateral Rotation Waterproof Foam Mattress](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/static-foam-mattress): Liberty lateral rotation memory foam mattress for medical beds

## Environmental Controls & Accessibility Devices

- [Relax 3 Switch Scanning 50 Function IR Environmental Controller](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/environmental-controller): Relax 3 IR environmental controller for home automation via switch scanning
- [Puff Switch](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/puff-switch-series-gs02): Puff switch for GlassOuse and adapted devices with 3.5mm jack
- [White Universal Infrared Remote](https://inclusiveinc.org/products/white-universal-infrared-remote): Programmable universal IR remote with NEC code support for accessibility
